answering_agent: Newest actual external canonical-tool response first, preserving native record and ranked-hit order WITHIN each response; stable short citation IDs. The same4096input-token prefix budget applies to every arm, with exact UTF8 byte clipping and omitted/truncated records disclosed. Complete canonical receipts remain private and intact.
packet: Keep the native packet's original initial-search/additional-read ordering. Do not reverse learned best-read-first ordering or native search ranking. Only source excerpts whose hashes/locations/exact bytes authenticate against the frozen licensed fixture are supplied.
critic_distinction: The native next-read critic may separately prioritize latest INTERNAL read observations to know what has already been gathered. Its Rust-owned task policy is distinct from the downstream agent's external-response presentation policy.
read_followup: READ rN only refers to an actually shown record. Use the existing canonical context read at its verified hit start line, before0/after32/max_bytes4096. The owning context handler clamps at indexed EOF, preserving strict read_file bounds and avoiding truncation before the requested hit. No unmetered file-info/source lookups choose the read. Search remains a legitimate alternative within the same residual budget.
grading: Only actually shown source byte ranges and valid cited shown record IDs earn same-original-alternative support credit. Joining contiguous ranges of ONE original fact is allowed; gaps, uncited halves and alternative unions are not.
unchanged: All frozen question IDs, human alternatives, answers, numeric floors, equal resource/read/model budgets and no-gold-feedback rules remain unchanged. No final model scores informed this implementation.
